violation_type.title: Use Zones - Licensed Before September 1, 2003 - Slides (26 TAC §746.4815(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Use Zones - Licensed Before September 1, 2003 - Slides
violation_type.typical_finding: A slide on the playground has a use zone that is less than 5 feet from the bottom of the slide.

finding_variants.text: A slide on the playground has a use zone that is less than 5 feet from the bottom of the slide.

During the playground inspection, there was a slide that did not have a use zone of six-foot use zone in front of it and a four-foot use zone around it.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the slide was removed.
